mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures that lead to tighter monetary policy, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which historically correlates with increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals weakening supply-side fundamentals, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < 0% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 8% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines, it signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS MoM < 0%, and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%, and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST YoY > 10% and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows below 1% quarter-over-quarter and industrial production (INDPRO) declines, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ < 1% and INDPRO MoM < 0%, and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.
